 "h0[10:]+salt": (h0[10:] + salt).encode(),

from PIL import Image
im = Image.open('/app/code.png').convert('L')
w,h = im.size
# find rows with dark pixels to locate text lines
import numpy as np
a = np.array(im)
dark = (a < 128).sum(axis=1)
rows = [i for i in range(h) if dark[i] > 5]
# group consecutive
groups = []
start = rows[0]
prev = rows[0]
for r in rows[1:]:
    if r - prev > 10:
        groups.append((start, prev))
        start = r
    prev = r
groups.append((start, prev))
print(groups)
